name: Majokko Kuru
source:
Witch Kid. A mirror world resident who looks just like Harukaze Kurumi-chan. A super silly alien from the ‘Dayomon Star’. Refers to herself as ‘Boku’.

"My name is Kuro-dayon. I came to save the world like a goldfish~♪"

She says things like this in a lisping, sweet voice while using magic to create a space called the Pink Time-Space, dragging everyone into trouble.

But her actions stem from a ‘good heart’. The mirror world she lives in is the flip side of the world where Alto-kun lives.

To save the mirror world that has become clouded, she creates a pink-hued space in Alto-kun's world, where feelings of love have grown scarce, trying to make everyone fall in love.

But somehow, it turns into an erotic space where everyone gets horny...

[Special Note: Breast Size]
So big you'll want to bury your face in them while teasing her in a seated position—Marshmallow Boin-chan.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080419050611/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_05.html]archived official site[/url]]
